event.description: Remove the three remaining shared LayerNorm additive bias vectors while retaining LayerNorm scales/statistics, cross-layer norm sharing, reversed operands, d=14, two heads, two blocks, ff=19, rank-3 learned positions, and the 45000-step schedule.
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Retained incumbent is 3073 parameters at 99.710000%, a +0.710000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no accepted normalization compression; the most recent failed result is attempt-0016, no LayerNorm biases in the earlier rank-8 forward-order architecture, an optimization failure with 10.25% peak validation; 3 prior normalization attempts. The immediately preceding in-block normalization-tying attempt-0040 is an optimization failure (45000 steps, 10% peak validation, no checkpoint), not a scored nonqualification. Hypothesis: with only three affine LayerNorm modules remaining after the accepted cross-layer sharing, their additive offsets may be redundant while learned scales and LayerNorm statistics retain calibration; this removes 42 actual scalar parameters (3073 to 3031). This is parameterization-preserving normalization compression, not a representational substitution. It is more informative than RMSNorm because it isolates learned offsets without changing the normalization statistic or the accepted sharing arrangement.
